title: Forbidden City Sold Out? Your Plan B Is a 700-Year-Old Beijing Walk | China Travel Expert
description:
Forbidden City tickets sold out? Here's a Plan B you can do entirely on foot.

Palace Museum tickets are released online seven days ahead, at 8 pm Beijing time, with real-name booking and no sales at the gate — so a sold-out day is common. Walk Beijing's old heart instead: the White Stupa of Miaoying Temple, a Tibetan-style dagoba standing here since 1279, rises white over the grey hutong roofs, with the Temple of Heaven's cypress paths and the Summer Palace lake easy to add on. All of it filmed on foot.

🧭 Expert Tip: if the Palace Museum is sold out, set an alarm for 8 pm Beijing time seven days before your date — that's exactly when the next batch opens.
